_comment: Shared cross-back-end conformance fixture asserting that an out-of-range `warble_ir_version` is a loud, explicit failure on every back-end — never a silent best-effort read. Unlike `conditional.json` (shared only between dispatcher/claude-code-cli and dispatcher/claude-agent-sdk, because dispatcher/vercel does not realize the conditional/when guard decision layer), this is the first fixture in this directory shared across all THREE back-ends: IR-version validation is symmetric — every target copies the same SUPPORTED_IR_VERSION(S) constant and rejects the same out-of-range input the same way, at the very first line of its emit/parse path, before anything else about the IR is inspected. The `ir` below is otherwise a minimal-but-schema-valid document (empty `components`) so each back-end's deserializer accepts it cleanly and the version check is the only thing that trips.
